Now I have good information on three crossbows:

1. **Tenpoint Turbo GT** (id: 875577) - 360 FPS, 175 lbs draw weight, 107 FP-KE, 6.5 lbs weight. Reviews mention:
   - "I've shot the bow out to 50 yards and it groups nicely (within 2" group)"
   - "I shot it 60 yards into a two by four and it pierced through the other side"
   - "I was shooting 2" groups from 60 yards"
   - "3rd shot bulls-eye at 30 yards"
   - "grouped 3 in a 1/2 spread very impressive right out the box"
   - Very positive reviews overall, winner of 2016 Game and Fish Reader's Choice Award

2. **Barnett Quad 400** (id: 77179) - 345 FPS, 150 lbs draw weight, 112 FP-KE, 9 lbs weight. Reviews mention:
   - "I JUST SHOT A 2INCH GROUP AT 70 YARDS"
   - "I took 3 shots from my house, about 65 yards, and all were 8-10 inches apart, including one dead center"
   - "At 40 yards I can shoot a group inside of a 4 in circle"
   - BUT also has significant reliability issues (limbs splitting, strings breaking, etc.)

3. **PSE Fang Series** (id: 663513) - 350 FPS, 155 lbs draw weight, 6.8 lbs weight. Reviews mention:
   - "I have been able to shoot out to 45 yards and still hit dead bullseye"
   - "At 40 yards I can shoot a group inside of a 4 in circle"
   - "I took it out of the box and was able to drill my target from 40 yards on the first shot"
   - "After 4-5 shots I was nailing bullseyes and 4" groups at 30 yds"
   - "I shot a deer at 47 yards completely comfortably"
   - BUT also has some limb splitting issues

The user is looking for:
- Super efficient (lightweight, compact, good power-to-weight ratio)
- Can accurately hit an apple-sized target (about 3 inches) at 40-50 yards

The Tenpoint Turbo GT seems to be the best match:
- 6.5 lbs (lightest of the three)
- 360 FPS (fastest)
- 107 FP-KE
- Compact 13.5-inch bow assembly
- Reviews consistently mention tight groups at 40-50+ yards (2" groups at 50 yards, 1/2" spread)
- Very positive reviews with no major reliability issues mentioned
- Winner of 2016 Game and Fish Reader's Choice Award

The PSE Fang is also a good option:
- 6.8 lbs (light)
- 350 FPS
- Reviews mention hitting bullseye at 45 yards
- More affordable

Let me recommend the Tenpoint Turbo GT as the primary recommendation and the PSE Fang as a budget alternative.
